messages.subject: For Patrice Caine | Corporate affairs, government relations and international partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Bonnet,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Patrice Caine, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

Thales operates across international technology markets where institutional relationships, regulation and strategic partnerships shape long-term growth. Those priorities closely match my current executive responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex multinational operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of corporate affairs, government relations and emerging-market stakeholder execution could support Thales internationally. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Thales.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
